nodes.rationale: Today is worked out only in the browser because the server may be in another time zone; the column is kept quieter than the lists and fixed at 256 px.

nodes.label: Styling on Refactoring UI scales (globals.css)
nodes.rationale: Spacing, type, weights, radius, shadows and role colours are scales; new values are not invented, the nearest step is used.

nodes.label: APP_ORIGIN setting
nodes.rationale: Must be exactly the address people type; the backend compares the origin exactly, so DEV_HOST must be lowercase.

nodes.label: Courses group students
nodes.rationale: An assignment or announcement given to a course reaches its students, including ones added later.

nodes.label: dev.sh local dev launcher
nodes.rationale: Needs the CyberP conda env (alembic, uvicorn). Backend starts on 8003 and moves to the next free port; site and hub listen on 127.0.0.1 by default.

nodes.label: dev-tunnel.sh tunnel to iqsec.cs.utep.edu
nodes.rationale: On iqsec only SSH gets through the firewall, so dev.sh is shared through an SSH tunnel with LISTEN_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1.

nodes.label: Gradebook (Progress and grades)
nodes.rationale: Opening a submission copies it into the teacher's notebook environment: read it, never run it; the autograder is the safe place to run student code.

nodes.label: JupyterHub admin panel (s-<id> / t-<id> hub users)
nodes.norm_label: jupyterhub admin panel (s-<id> / t-<id> hub users)
nodes.rationale: Hub's own admin panel; up to three servers per user (default, cpu, gpu). Add Users creates hub-only users; Edit User changes are overwritten.

nodes.label: Made-up usernames (adjective + noun + digits)
nodes.rationale: Word lists avoid people, bodies, violence and double-meaning animals; joined pairs are checked against a blocked list; never reuses a taken name.

nodes.label: app.manage command line (create-user, set-admin, set-password, list-users)
nodes.norm_label: app.manage command line (create-user, set-admin, set-password, list-users)

nodes.label: Otter Assign notebook format
nodes.rationale: Otter builds the students' version at upload and refuses the upload if the teacher's solutions fail their tests; the platform runs otter assign itself in the grader.

nodes.label: Otter-Grader autograding
nodes.rationale: Chosen over nbgrader; a student's notebook is graded in an isolated container, never inside the backend (which can reach the database), and scores are stored in Postgres.

nodes.label: Account themes (Standard, Halloween, Retro 95)
nodes.rationale: Saved per account (users.theme) and mirrored in a cyberai_theme cookie so the first paint is right.

nodes.label: UTEP server deployment (git pull, docker compose up --build, migrations)
nodes.norm_label: utep server deployment (git pull, docker compose up --build, migrations)
nodes.rationale: Steps live in deploy/README.md; APP_ORIGIN must match the address users type; site and hub must share a parent domain.

nodes.label: notes.md (project decisions, how-tos and status log)
nodes.norm_label: notes.md (project decisions, how-tos and status log)

nodes.label: Shield Emblem with Cyan Core (cybersecurity brand mark)
nodes.norm_label: shield emblem with cyan core (cybersecurity brand mark)

nodes.label: Admins reset other admins' passwords
nodes.rationale: Asks for your own password first so a browser left logged in, or a login hijacked through a student notebook in --lan mode, cannot lock other admins out.

nodes.label: Admin rights given from the site
nodes.norm_label: admin rights given from the site
nodes.rationale: Replaces command-line-only admin rights. Acting admin re-types their password; students never made admins; nobody removes their own rights; rows are locked so two admins revoking each other cannot leave zero admins.

nodes.label: Assignment data files (datasets) copied per student
nodes.norm_label: assignment data files (datasets) copied per student
nodes.rationale: Copies never overwrite a student's files; at most 4 copies at once to protect backend memory; Otter's files: list carries data into grading, which has no network; 20 files / 50 MB per assignment.

nodes.label: Assignment folder named <title>-<id>
nodes.rationale: Deleting an assignment and re-uploading a corrected one under the same title never hands students the old file.

nodes.label: Brand: navy bar with cyan accent
nodes.norm_label: brand: navy bar with cyan accent
nodes.rationale: Not UTEP's orange, and the UTEP name is not written in the site.

nodes.label: Classroom address cyberai.local (idea, not built)
nodes.rationale: mDNS name needs no DNS server; plain http only since no certificate can be issued for .local, so use a classroom router, not campus Wi-Fi.

nodes.label: Dialog focus fix (autoFocus ran before the dialog opened)
nodes.norm_label: dialog focus fix (autofocus ran before the dialog opened)
nodes.rationale: The browser focused the Close button, so a space typed into the field closed the dialog; contents now mount once the dialog is open.

nodes.label: Server-generated passwords shown once
nodes.rationale: Only the hash is stored, so the password cannot be shown again.

nodes.label: GPU notebooks turned off (GPU_NOTEBOOKS setting)
nodes.rationale: GPU assignments open in the CPU environment sharing the same home so files survive; the hub refuses GPU servers outright because teachers pass the GPU check through the teachers group.

nodes.label: Grader service (isolated grading containers)
nodes.rationale: Only service besides the hub with the Docker socket; the backend never gets it. Each job runs in a throwaway container with no network, 2 GB, one CPU, five minutes. No database access; only the backend can reach it.

nodes.label: Login/logout also ends the JupyterHub session
nodes.norm_label: login/logout also ends the jupyterhub session
nodes.rationale: The next person on a shared computer does not get the previous person's notebooks.

nodes.label: No phone layout: iPad and desktop only
nodes.norm_label: no phone layout: ipad and desktop only

nodes.label: Knowledge checks (server-checked, three tries, practice only)
nodes.norm_label: knowledge checks (server-checked, three tries, practice only)
nodes.rationale: Never reach the gradebook; students are never sent the answers before a question is closed.

nodes.label: ./dev.sh --lan network mode
nodes.rationale: Plain http for trusted testers and test accounts only; new hub, OAuth and grader secrets on every start; site and notebooks share one address so it is not for a class.

nodes.label: Lessons as a list of blocks (Markdown, not WYSIWYG)
nodes.norm_label: lessons as a list of blocks (markdown, not wysiwyg)
nodes.rationale: Blocks (text, code, callout, picture, video, notebook link, multiple choice, short answer) stored as JSON in Postgres with their pictures; text is Markdown as in notebook cells. Videos are YouTube-only (cookie-less); pictures are uploaded, never hot-linked.

nodes.label: Lesson working copy vs published copy
nodes.norm_label: lesson working copy vs published copy
nodes.rationale: Students never see half-typed edits; 'Publish changes' hands over the new version.

nodes.label: Lesson .zip export and import
nodes.rationale: Exports the working copy; imports are drafts, all or nothing in one transaction; linked autograded notebooks travel with solutions and hidden tests, so the file is for teachers only; 100 MB / 200 lessons limit.

nodes.label: Light or dark mode for every theme (users.color_mode)
nodes.norm_label: light or dark mode for every theme (users.color_mode)
nodes.rationale: Dark colours are written twice instead of using light-dark(), which needs iPadOS 17.5+; a test keeps the copies equal and checks contrast.

nodes.label: Login lockout (5 wrong passwords, 15-minute wait)
nodes.rationale: Counters live in backend memory, so restarting the backend clears them.

nodes.label: Changing an assignment's notebook after upload
nodes.norm_label: changing an assignment's notebook after upload
nodes.rationale: Allowed only until the first student opens it; the save locks the assignment row so no student gets the old file after a replace.

nodes.label: Same-origin check on state-changing requests
nodes.rationale: Requests from any other address, including the hub where student notebook code runs, get 403.

nodes.label: Picture questions (multiple choice / true-false with a picture)
nodes.norm_label: picture questions (multiple choice / true-false with a picture)
nodes.rationale: Not a new block type: a multiple-choice question with an optional picture, so grading, tries and the gradebook rule are unchanged.

nodes.label: Notebooks, submissions and grades stored in Postgres
nodes.norm_label: notebooks, submissions and grades stored in postgres
nodes.rationale: No assignments folder on the server, so backing up the database backs everything up.

nodes.label: Question points check against score tampering
nodes.norm_label: question points check against score tampering
nodes.rationale: Otter runs student code next to the hidden tests, so code could sway its own score; the empty students' version is graded at upload to get real points, and results claiming other questions or points are flagged in the gradebook.

nodes.label: Shared re-authentication guess limit (auth.REAUTH)
nodes.rationale: A stolen admin session gets 5 guesses in all per 15 minutes, not 5 per page. Any new password also stops the account's notebook servers and hub login.

nodes.label: Request size limits (10 MB notebook, 20 MB submission, 1 MB other)
nodes.norm_label: request size limits (10 mb notebook, 20 mb submission, 1 mb other)
nodes.rationale: An upload is only read after the account is checked, so a non-teacher cannot push a big file at the server.

nodes.label: CPU and memory limits in deploy/.env
nodes.norm_label: cpu and memory limits in deploy/.env
nodes.rationale: Caps, not reservations; memory runs out first because idle kernels are not stopped.

nodes.label: Privilege review security fixes
nodes.rationale: New secrets on every dev.sh start, hub bound to localhost, teachers no longer JupyterHub admins (that role opened every notebook server to every teacher). Finding 3 needs a wildcard DNS name from UTEP IT.

nodes.label: Settings menu for teachers and admins (superseded)
nodes.norm_label: settings menu for teachers and admins (superseded)
nodes.rationale: The menu only hides links; every section's data comes from the API, which checks admin/teacher flags from the database on every request.

nodes.label: Exporting students' progress and grades (.xlsx / CSV)
nodes.norm_label: exporting students' progress and grades (.xlsx / csv)
nodes.rationale: Teachers may export every student since they already see every gradebook; rows by username only; formula-looking CSV cells get a leading quote and are stored as text in Excel.

nodes.label: Student submission flow and statuses
nodes.rationale: Submit takes the notebook as saved; resubmitting replaces the earlier submission and grade; late submissions are accepted and marked late.

nodes.label: Top bar Home / Teach / Admin areas
nodes.norm_label: top bar home / teach / admin areas
nodes.rationale: Replaces the 2026-10-02 decision to keep teaching inside Settings; old /settings links redirect via next.config.ts.

nodes.label: Tests never touch the platform database
nodes.norm_label: tests never touch the platform database
nodes.rationale: Tests run on their own in-memory Postgres (port 5434); conftest stops if DATABASE_URL is the platform's, and fakes every hub call as down.

nodes.label: Students have only a username (no real names)
nodes.norm_label: students have only a username (no real names)
nodes.rationale: The platform stores no real name for students; one rule refuses a student name on create and edit.

nodes.label: Grading service isolation (server)
nodes.rationale: Student code runs there, so it has no network, no database, no published port, and sits on a 'grading' network only the backend joins.

nodes.label: Moving lessons between platforms via .zip
nodes.rationale: No database copy or migration needed; a university proxy must allow 101 MB to /api/teach/lesson-imports.

nodes.label: CPU and memory caps for notebook servers and grading jobs
nodes.norm_label: cpu and memory caps for notebook servers and grading jobs
nodes.rationale: Caps, not reservations; memory runs out first. Backend waits up to an hour per grading job, queue included.

nodes.label: Edit in JupyterLab / Replace notebook (before first open)
nodes.norm_label: edit in jupyterlab / replace notebook (before first open)
nodes.rationale: The notebook is frozen once a student opens it: their copy is theirs and would no longer match the tests.

nodes.label: Gradebook
nodes.rationale: Read opened submissions, do not run them: the teacher's environment has network access and hidden tests in reach.

nodes.label: Grading service (grader/)
nodes.rationale: Student code never runs in the backend: each job gets a new no-network container of the notebook image (2 GB, one CPU, process limit, 5 minutes); only service besides the hub with the Docker socket, and it has no database access.

nodes.label: Hidden tests readable by student code during grading
nodes.norm_label: hidden tests readable by student code during grading
nodes.rationale: Otter runs student code and tests in one process; mitigated by counting only the teacher's questions and points and flagging mismatches in the gradebook.

nodes.label: Lesson .zip export/import (format version 1)
nodes.rationale: The .zip carries solutions, hidden tests and check answers, so it must be kept from students; import is all-or-nothing and lands as drafts.

nodes.label: Students' progress and grades export (CSV / Excel)
nodes.norm_label: students' progress and grades export (csv / excel)

nodes.label: CSV formula-injection guard
nodes.rationale: Cells starting with =, +, -, @, tab or CR get a leading ' so a spreadsheet never runs them as formulas.

nodes.label: Assignment data files (datasets)
nodes.rationale: Each student gets an own copy that is never overwritten; added to Otter's files: list because grading has no network; stored in Postgres (assignment_files) so backups cover them.

nodes.label: dev-tunnel.sh (SSH tunnel to a server)
nodes.rationale: For a server whose firewall lets only SSH through: runs ./dev.sh --lan there and forwards ports 3000 and 8081 from your computer.

nodes.label: LAN mode (dev.sh --lan)
nodes.rationale: Only for trying the site with trusted people: plain http, site and notebooks share one address so a notebook server receives the platform login; dev.sh makes new random secrets every start.

nodes.label: Postgres 16 database
nodes.rationale: Dev uses the same Postgres 16 as production, on port 5433 so it does not clash with a Postgres installed on the Mac.

nodes.label: Models subclass Base (api/app/db.py) and are imported in env.py
nodes.norm_label: models subclass base (api/app/db.py) and are imported in env.py
nodes.rationale: Autogenerate only sees imported models; always read a generated migration before applying it.

nodes.label: Code syntax highlighting (highlight.js via lowlight/rehype-highlight)
nodes.rationale: Returns a tree React draws, never HTML; unknown languages are shown as-is, never guessed.

nodes.label: Lesson blocks (text, code, callout, picture, video, notebook, questions)
nodes.norm_label: lesson blocks (text, code, callout, picture, video, notebook, questions)

nodes.label: Lesson working copy and Publish
nodes.rationale: Students keep the published version while the teacher edits; publishing is refused while a question is unfinished.

nodes.label: Write or paste a whole lesson as text
nodes.norm_label: write or paste a whole lesson as text

nodes.label: Server-checked knowledge checks
nodes.rationale: The student's browser never receives correct options, accepted answers or explanations; three tries; practice only, not graded.

nodes.label: One-time PLATFORM_HUB_API_TOKEN rotation
nodes.rationale: Earlier versions sent the token to every student's notebook server, where student code could have copied it.

nodes.label: api/app/jupyter (OAuth2 provider, hub REST client, launch/stop API)
nodes.norm_label: api/app/jupyter (oauth2 provider, hub rest client, launch/stop api)

nodes.label: jupyterhub_config.py (OAuth, profiles, GPU limits, iframe CSP)
nodes.norm_label: jupyterhub_config.py (oauth, profiles, gpu limits, iframe csp)

nodes.label: platform-role hub permissions
nodes.rationale: Can create users, start servers and mint tokens for any user, so it reaches every home in the end: keep it only in deploy/.env.

nodes.label: Updating a running server (git pull, build, migrate)
nodes.norm_label: updating a running server (git pull, build, migrate)
nodes.rationale: Run the migration every time: new versions add tables and columns, and pages that use them error until they exist.

nodes.label: Roles: student, teacher, admin flag
nodes.rationale: Platform admins are JupyterHub admins but teachers are not, because JupyterHub's admin role opens every notebook server.

nodes.label: Per-operation hub tokens (two minutes, one server)
nodes.norm_label: per-operation hub tokens (two minutes, one server)

nodes.label: Per-server short-lived hub tokens
nodes.rationale: PLATFORM_HUB_API_TOKEN is never sent to a student's notebook server where student code could read it.

nodes.label: Secret strength check at backend start
nodes.norm_label: secret strength check at backend start
nodes.rationale: Backend refuses secrets shorter than 32 characters or containing 'dev-' or 'change-me', so development defaults never reach a server.

nodes.label: Password-guessing lockout behind Caddy (in-memory, one uvicorn worker)
nodes.norm_label: password-guessing lockout behind caddy (in-memory, one uvicorn worker)
nodes.rationale: Counters live in backend memory; backend trusts X-Forwarded-For, so it must be reachable only through Caddy.

nodes.label: Security test suite (test_security.py and teacher-API tests)
nodes.norm_label: security test suite (test_security.py and teacher-api tests)

nodes.label: Picture validation by file signature (no SVG)
nodes.norm_label: picture validation by file signature (no svg)
nodes.rationale: Accepted by how the file starts, never by its name; SVG refused because it can carry scripts.

nodes.label: Lesson .zip zip-bomb protection
nodes.rationale: Never unpacked to disk; only files named in lessons.json are read, each with its own limit and 300 MB in all.

nodes.label: Admin action log (docker compose logs backend)
nodes.norm_label: admin action log (docker compose logs backend)

nodes.label: Admin > Accounts management
nodes.rationale: Changing another admin's password or admin rights asks for your own password again, so a browser left logged in cannot lock out the other admins.

nodes.label: Gamertag-style username suggestions (api/app/usernames.py)
nodes.rationale: Students have no names, only usernames; generated server-side from word lists checked so no pairing spells anything rude.

nodes.label: Server-side role checks with a script-unreadable session cookie
nodes.norm_label: server-side role checks with a script-unreadable session cookie
nodes.rationale: The browser stores nothing about role or password; admin/teacher is decided on the server for every request.

nodes.label: CPU and GPU student notebook images
nodes.norm_label: cpu and gpu student notebook images
nodes.rationale: Also the images submissions are graded in, so they include Otter-Grader; docker compose does not build them.

nodes.label: reset-student.sh (archive and wipe a student's home volume)
nodes.norm_label: reset-student.sh (archive and wipe a student's home volume)

nodes.label: First server setup: images, stack, migration, first admin
nodes.norm_label: first server setup: images, stack, migration, first admin
nodes.rationale: The server's database starts empty; accounts from a laptop are not copied, so the admin is created again with its own long password.

nodes.label: Production migration (docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head)
nodes.norm_label: production migration (docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head)

nodes.label: api/requirements-dev.txt (test and lint tools)
nodes.rationale: For working on the platform, not for running it.

nodes.label: Migration tests (apply, roll back, match models)
nodes.norm_label: migration tests (apply, roll back, match models)
nodes.rationale: Says tests run in a throwaway database on the dev Postgres; README.md says a separate test Postgres on port 5434 - likely stale.

nodes.label: Tests use their own throwaway Postgres (port 5434)
nodes.norm_label: tests use their own throwaway postgres (port 5434)
nodes.rationale: Tests never reach the platform's database; conftest points DATABASE_URL at the test Postgres and refuses the platform's.

nodes.label: APP_DOMAIN and HUB_DOMAIN share a parent domain
nodes.norm_label: app_domain and hub_domain share a parent domain
nodes.rationale: Needed so logging out also ends the hub session on shared computers, and so Admin > JupyterHub can be framed.
